column1: # CaliciNet monthly norovirus outbreak genotype percentages, United States.
# Source: Barclay L, Vinje J. Increasing Predominance of Norovirus GII.17 over GII.4,
# United States, 2022-2025. Emerg Infect Dis 31(7), 2025. Figure 2.
# Values are transcribed from the data table printed beneath Figure 2.
# Figure 2 reports only GII.4 and GII.17 against a grey "Total" envelope of all outbreaks.
# The two named percentages do not sum to 100, so the remainder is other genotypes; it is
# derived here as other_pct = 100 - gii4_pct - gii17_pct.
